tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ dpal ldan sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi gsung 'bum po ti dang po (ka )pa'i nang na bzhugs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ dpal sa skya pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams la bstod pa pad+ma ra ga'i phreng ba/1 rje btsun gong ma lnga la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa yid kyi 'dod 'jo/2 gong bstod/3gong gong ma'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs kun 'jug3'og rnal 'byor dbang phyug la bstod pa 'phags mchog ma/4 rnal 'byor dbang phyug la sku'i rnam 'gyur drug gi sgo nas bstod pa dngos grub char 'bebs/5 rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal thugs rje chen po la bstod pa nor bu'i do shal mkhas rnams dga' ba'i mdzes rgyan/6 dpal sa skya pa'i bla ma dam pa rje btsun chen po dang / chos rje khu dbon/ dpal ldan bla ma rnams la bstod pa'i rgya gzhung rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa bsod nams rab rgyas/7 rje btsun rin po che'i gsol 'debs skad gnyis sbyar ba ngo mtshar snang ba/8 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug la gsol ba 'debs pa bsam pa kun 'grub/9 sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la bstod pa dngos grub mchog stsol 'dod don kun 'grub/10 srid gsum gyi bla ma dpal sa skya pa chen po 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dbang po'i mtshan can la gsol ba 'debs pa yid 'phrog lha'i ljon shing /11 bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa dad pa rab g.yo/12 bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa'i yig chung byin rlabs myur 'jug13 mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal sa skya pa chen po grub mchog bsod nams dbang po la gsol ba 'debs pa don gnyis lhun grub/14 gsol 'debs nyes pa'i mun sel/15 sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa legs pa'i 'byung gnas/16

sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros la gsol 'debs snying gi thig le/17 bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa dgos 'dod kun 'byung /18 dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gsol ba 'debs pa bsam pa lhun grub/19 dpal sa skya pa chen po yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros la gsol ba 'debs pa dgos 'dod kun 'byung gi nor bu'i phreng mdzes/20 drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'chang chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs pa smon lam dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dgos 'dod bsam 'phel/21 'khor lo'i mgon po rgyal ba mus pa chen po bud+dha'i mtshan can la gsol ba 'debs pa ngo mtshar ut+pa la'i phreng ba/22 rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs pa smon lam dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa byin rlabs bde chen 'byung ba/23 rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la bstod pa snyan dngags kyi 'khor lo ngo mtshar snang ba/24 rje rgyal ba mus pa chen po la gdung dbyangs kyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa bsam don kun 'grub/25 bla ma mus pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs pa yid kyi 'dod 'jo/26 rje bla ma mus pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dad pa'i myu gu/27 rje rgyal ba mus pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs myur du 'gugs pa'i pho nya/28 bla ma rgyang 'bod kyi tshigs su bcad pa snying gi gdung dbyangs/29 bla ma la brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa bsam don kun 'grub/30 rje bla ma mus pa chen po'i gsung gi bdud rtsi'i zegs ma dad pa'i dpal ster/31 rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa 'chi med dbang po'i rnga sgra/32 rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub/33 rang la bka' drin che ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa dngos grub mchog stsol/34

grub thob kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba dpal sa skya pa chen po mthu stobs dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs pa dngos grub ma lus pa 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/35 dpal chos kyi rje kun dga' mtshan can la bstod pa ngo mtshar me tog gi phreng ba/36 lo nas spyan snga rin po che'i mdzad pa'i lam 'bras slob bshad rtsod spong la bsngags pa brjod pa'i rab byed/37 mtshungs med nags dgon pa chen po sbyin pa grags pa la bstod pa rin po che'i mgul rgyan/38 thub bstan lha chen gyi mkhan chen la bstod pa rab snyan lha'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so/38'og / rje nags dgon pa chen po sbyin pa grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs pa don gnyis lhun grub/39 rje dbang phyug rab brtan la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs myur du 'byung ba'i pho nya/40 grub pa mchog gi ded dpon chos kyi rje dbang phyug rab brtan la bstod pa lha rdzas me tog gi chun po/41 chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la bstod pa dad gus thugs rje'i char 'bebs/42 chos kyi rje mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa la gsol ba 'debs pa dad pa'i me tog43 bdag bstod bskul byed dga' bskyed nyid rgyas par phye ba'i yi ge44 brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs don gnyis mthar phyin/45 brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs kyi kha skong yar ngo'i zla dbang /46 brtan bzhugs bsam pa lhun grub/47 grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs pa dgos 'dod kun 'byung /48 grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po thang stong rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan mchog gi dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rin po che'i tog49 gsol 'debs kyi yi ge yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng mdzes/50 rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi skyes chen dam pa rgyan drug mchog gnyis la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa'i rab tu byed pa sarka bzhi pa/51

rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' bzang po la bstod pa dad pa'i snye ma/52 kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge la bstod pa dad pa rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng /53 rje btsun mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs pa don gnyis lhun grub/54 rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po'i gsol 'debs don gnyis lhun grub/55 rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs char 'bebs/56 skyid grong jo bo rin po che la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs bcad don gnyis lhun grub/57 rje btsun sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe khrid kyi brgyud 'debs kha skong dang bcas pa/58 'ba' ra lugs kyi tshe khrid kyi brgyud 'debs 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i rdo rje/59 slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas la gu ru'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs 'ga' zhig rnam thar mdor bsdus dang sbyar nas bstod pa bar chad kun sel/60 slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas la thugs rje myur bskul gyi gsol 'debs bsam pa myur 'grub bod khams kun du bde ba'i dpal ster/61 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bcu drug la mchod cing bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa'i byin rlabs char 'bebs/62 lam zab brgyud 'debs bsam pa lhun grub/63 rigs 'dzin bskul gyi kha skong /64 phur pa'i brgyud 'debs kha skong 65/ gshed dmar spros med kyi zab mo'i khrid kyi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs char 'bebs bzhugs/65'og bde kye gsang gsum gyi bla ma brgyud pa la nang mchod 'bul ba'i skabs dang brgyud 'debs skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i kha skong /66 phar tshad brgyud 'debs kyi kun mkhyen chen po'i rjes su sbyar rgyu'i gsol 'debs kyi tshigs bcad yid kyi 'dod 'jo/67 (rdo rje phur pa'i drag po sgrol dbang gi brgyud 'debs kyi kha skong dang /68 dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi drag po'i las bskul dang cho ga'i bsgrigs rim/69

rigs 'dzin brgyud 'debs bar chad kun sel/70 rigs 'dzin bla ma brgyud pa rnams la ja mchod 'bul ba'i tshigs su bcad pa ci bsam kun 'grub/71'di rnams chad/) 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa byin rlabs bskul byed/72 tshangs pa'i bu mo dbyangs can ma la bstod pa rgyan gyi phreng ba/73 gur drag bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kha skong /74 bde mchog brgyud 'debs kyi kha skong /75 (dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'phrin las 'dod 'jo/76 rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong /77 rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong dkar po'i phyogs kyi bsil zer can/78 rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong don gnyis lhun grub/79'di rnams chad/) rig byed lha mo gtso bor gyur pa'i dmar po skor gsum la bstod cing 'phrin las 'chol ba'i tshigs su bcad pa dngos grub char 'bebs don gnyis lhun grub/80 thub bstan lha chen gyi mchod rol la bsngags pa'i tshigs bcad/81 thub bstan lha chen du bla bre phul ba'i yi ge82 thub bstan lha chen du rnga bo che phul ba'i yi ge83 lha sa'i jo bo rin po che la snyan zhal mdzes byed phul ba'i kha yig84 yin thang la na bza' phul ba'i yi ge85 rje btsun rin po che'i sku 'dra mdze thod ma'i drung du phul ba'i mchod rdzas kyi kha yig86 gsol 'debs dgos 'dod kun 'byung /87 dges bzhin gnang ba'i zhal gdams dgos 'dod kun 'grub las zur du bkol ba/88 gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub/89 bshags pa dang smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa re ba kun 'grub/90 smon lam thar pa'i sgo 'byed/91 gsol 'debs re ba kun 'grub/92 gsol 'debs byin rlabs yid ches ldan pa/93 byams pa'i sku 'dra gsung byon ma'i bstod pa/94

bla ma dam pa'i sku 'dra phyag nas ma la snyan dar phul ba'i kha yig95 gsol 'debs yid kyi 'dod 'jo/96 bshags pa'i tshigs bcad sgrib pa kun sel/97 smon lam bsam pa kun 'grub/98 gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa don gnyis lhun grub/99 gsol 'debs 'dod pa'i 'bras stsol/100 gsol 'debs smon lam bsam pa lhun grub/101 gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa'i rab tu byed pa dgos 'dod kun 'grub/102 bshags pa dang smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa re ba kun 'grub/103 rang la bka' drin can a ma lags gshegs rjes cher gtad brtsams pa'i smon lam 'gro ba'i bsod nams ma/104 gsol 'debs bsam pa myur 'grub/105 bshags pa dang smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa re ba kun 'grub/106 gsol 'debs kyi yi ge ci bsam lhun grub/107 smon lam re ba kun 'grub/108 rje tshar chen yab sras kyi sku gdung la gdung tsha btab pa'i grangs dang dngul gdung dang sku 'dra rin po che bzhengs pa'i smon lam tshigs bcad bzhugs/109 shar chen nor bu'i phyi skor bzang spyod du song gi grangs smon lam dang bcas pa bzhugs/110 gsol 'debs smon lam bsam pa lhun grub bzhugs/111 gsol 'debs bsam pa myur 'grub bzhugs/112 phar tshad brgyud 'debs kha skong yod/113 gsung ngag rin po che'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi rnam thar mdor bsdus dang sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa mkhas pa dga' byed/114 dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa lam rim nyams su len tshul smon lam dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'phrin las mkha' khyab/115 gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag thob pa'i gang zag rnams kyi rang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa smon lam dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dgos 'dod kun 'byung /116 gur gyi mgon po'i chos skor gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bsam don kun 'grub/117

dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bar chad kun sel/118 dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bar chad kun sel/119 dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs phyi nang gsang ba'i lam gyi rim pa'i smon lam dang bcas pa/120 dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i gsang sgrub kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/121 'khor lo bde mchog gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs dngos grub char 'bebs/122 bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i chos skor gyi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs kyi rgya mtsho/123 dkar bdud kyi bstod pa dge legs phun tshogs/124 rang gzhan gyi don du bris pa'i mchod brjod kyi yi ge blo gsal tshim byed/125 dpal chos kyi rgyal po chen po 'phrin las bstan skyong dbang po la rab tu bsngags pa 'chi med gser gyi rnga chen/126 gsung mgur gyi skor la legs par bshad pa yid kyi gdung sel/127 nyams dbyangs mthong ba don ldan/128 nyams dbyangs bdag tu 'dzin pa'i mdud pa grol ba'i yan lag129 zhal gdams zin bris bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/130 rjes spyod nyams len gong 'phel gyi yi ge131 gsung ngag lam 'bras la thos bsam byed dus kyi rmi lam yi ger bris pa dad pa'i gsal 'debs/132 nyams dbyangs ngan pa'i spyod pa la khrel ba'i gtam/133 'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa'i bsnyen pa bya dus kyi nyams dbyangs nyams rtags bskyed pa'i sa bon/134 rang la rang gi gros 'debs kyi yi ge rang skyon sel ba'i sman mchog135 nyams dbyangs yon tan rin po che'i 'byung gnas/136 nyams dbyangs bar chad kun sel/137 nyams dbyangs phun tshogs rab rgyas/138 nyams mgur snyigs ma'i gtam/139 bla ma rgyang 'bod kyi tshigs su bcad pa rang gi spyod tshul la yid 'byung ba'i tshigs bcad/140

bdag bstod bskul byed rab dga'/141 nyams shar yi ger bris pa blo ldan dga' bskyed/142 nyams dbyangs ngan pa spyod pa'i zug rngu sel byed/143 nyams dbyangs tshe 'di'i zhen pa sel byed/144 nyams dbyangs gdan sa ma/145 rje mus chen la zhu yig phul ba'i rten gyi na bza' la phul ba'i yi ge146 sems skyo ba'i ngang nas ro 'dzin bsgyur ba 'ga' zhig phyogs gcig tu sdebs pa legs bshad yid 'byung bskyed byed/147 nyams dbyangs gsang ba'i yi ge148 nyams dbyangs ang bzhi ma/149 gdod ma'i bla ma la gsol 'debs kyi yi ge dad pa'i me tog150 nyams dbyangs snying gi mun sel/151 nyams dbyangs ngan pa'i spyod pas zug rngu bskyed pa'i 'bras bu/152 nyams dbyangs yid bde'i myu gu/153 ngan pa'i bsam sbyor la khrel ba'i gtam/154 nyams dbyangs gong ma'i zhu 'phrin/155 rang la smras pa'i nyams dbyangs/156 nyams dbyangs 'dir snang zhen pa gcod pa'i ral gri/157 dus ngan snyigs ma'i snang tshul la skyo ba'i gtam/158 nyams dbyangs dkon mchog thugs rje nyid/ /nye bar bskul ba'i yi ge zhes/159 snying gtam bzod pa gong 'phel/160 nyams shar yi ger bris pa dge legs 'byung gnas/161 sngar byung gi tshul rnams smras pa yid kyi shing rta/162 rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gsum la gdung dbyangs kyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa don gnyis lhun grub/163 nyams dbyangs bdud rtsi'i thigs 'phreng yid bde'i dpal ster/164 'bras rtsis kyi gsal byed/165 rang lo nyer gsum lon skabs nyin zhag phrugs re'i dge sbyor nyams len gyi rim pa rnams dang 'phral gyi kun spyod rnams chos dang mthun par spyod pa'i tshul sogs dran gso gsol 'debs kyi yi ge166 dgos byed khyad par can gyi tshe med thabs med pa'i yi ge167 rang lo nyer lnga lon skabs nyin zhag phrugs re'i dge sbyor nyams len gyi rim pa rnams dang 'phral gyi kun spyod rnams chos dang mthun par spyod pa'i tshul dran gso gsal 'debs kyi yi ge168
